```{python}
import pandas as pd

forms     = ["aqua", "rosa", "amō", "canis", "magnus", "videō", "puella", "bonus", "dominus", "portō", "lupus", "longus"]
glosses   = ["water", "rose", "I love", "dog", "big", "I see", "girl", "good", "lord", "I carry", "wolf", "long"]
pos       = ["noun", "noun", "verb", "noun", "adj", "verb", "noun", "adj", "noun", "verb", "noun", "adj"]
syllables = [2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 3, 3, 2, 3, 2, 2, 2]

latin_rows = []

for f, g, p, s in zip(forms, glosses, pos, syllables):
    latin_rows.append({
        "form": f,
        "gloss": g,
        "pos": p,
        "syllables": s
    })

latin_df = pd.DataFrame(latin_rows)
print(latin_df)

latin_df.to_csv("latin_lexicon.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")

check = pd.read_csv("latin_lexicon.csv")
print(check)
```

```{python}
import pandas as pd

root    = ["*bʰer-", "*ĝenh₁-", "*ped-", "*doh₃-"]
meaning = ["to carry", "to beget", "foot", "to give"]
latin   = ["ferō", "gignō", "pēs", "dō"]
greek   = ["pʰérō", "gígnomai", "poús", "dídōmi"]
english = ["bear", "kin", "foot", "donate"]

pie_rows = []

for r,m,l,g,e in zip(root,meaning, latin, greek, english):
    pie_rows.append({
        "root": r,
        "meaning": m,
        "latin": l,
        "greek": g,
        "english": e
    })
pie_df = pd.DataFrame(pie_rows)
print(pie_df)
```

```{python}
import re
import matplotlib
import pandas as pd


with open("../../../data/gutenberg/alice.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    alice_lines = f.readlines()

while not alice_lines[0].startswith("*** START"):
    alice_lines = alice_lines[1:]
alice_lines = alice_lines[1:]

while not alice_lines[-1].startswith("*** END"):
    alice_lines = alice_lines[:-1]
alice_lines = alice_lines[:-1]

alice_text = "".join(alice_lines)
### count chapters\/
chapters = re.split(r"\nCHAPTER [IVXL]+", alice_text)
chapters = chapters[1:]
####
rows = []
chapter_num = 0

for chapter in chapters:
    chapter_num += 1
    words = re.split(r"[\W]+", chapter.lower())
    words = [w for w in words if w != ""]
    for w in words:
        rows.append({"word": w, "chapter": chapter_num})

alice_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(alice_df)

len(alice_df)
#print(alice_df.head(30))
words = alice_df["word"]
len(words)

alice_df[alice_df["word"] == "queen"]
alice_df[alice_df["word"].str.endswith("ly")]
alice_df[alice_df["word"].str.startswith("un")]

print("alice",len(alice_df[alice_df["word"] == "alice"]))
print(alice_df[alice_df["word"].str.endswith("ing")])
un = alice_df[alice_df["word"].str.startswith("un")]
print("un",len(un))
un = un[un["word"] != "under"]  #get rid of under

alice_df[(alice_df["word"] == "queen") & (alice_df["chapter"] == 8)] # & for and
alice_df[(alice_df["word"] == "king") | (alice_df["word"] == "queen")]# | for or
alice_df[((alice_df["word"] == "king") | (alice_df["word"] == "queen")) & (alice_df["chapter"] == 8)] #both but is messy

alice_df[(alice_df["word"].isin(["king", "queen"])) & (alice_df["chapter"] == 8)] #use '.isin'

stopwords = ["the", "to", "and", "of", "a", "her", "i", "in", "was", "it",
             "she", "he", "be", "that", "you", "not", "had", "as", "his", "for",
             "with", "is", "have", "but", "at", "so", "all", "my", "been", "him",
             "on", "by", "could", "would", "very", "no", "what", "which", "they",
             "were", "there", "me", "an", "must", "this", "said", "from", "or",
             "will", "any", "much", "than", "such", "their", "them", "if", "do",
             "did", "one", "when", "your", "more", "are", "we", "who", "up",
             "out", "down", "into", "s", "t"]

alice_df[alice_df["word"].isin(stopwords)]


content = alice_df[~alice_df["word"].isin(stopwords)]#use ~ to say 'not'

```
